title: Recurring drafts
subtitle: Templates that create expense, vendor-bill, or billing drafts on a schedule. Generation never posts money — you still approve each draft.

notAllowed.title: No access
notAllowed.body: You need expense, vendor-bill, or billing permission to view recurring drafts.

empty.title: No recurring drafts yet
empty.body: Save a template for rent, retainers, or regular vendor bills. Each run creates a draft only — nothing is approved or posted automatically.

create.title: New recurring draft
create.description: The schedule only creates drafts. Approve the expense, post the vendor bill, or finalize billing separately.

detail.title: Recurring draft
detail.draftOnlyNote: Generate now creates a draft only. It does not approve an expense, post a vendor bill, or finalize billing.

actions.generateBody: This creates one draft from the template. Money is not posted until you approve or finalize that draft yourself.

success.generated: Draft created. It is not posted.

confirm.endBody: Ended templates stop generating. Existing drafts are unchanged.

errors.notActive: Paused templates cannot generate drafts. Resume the template first.
errors.notPausable: Only active templates can be paused.
errors.notResumable: Only paused templates can be resumed.
errors.endBeforeNext: The end date cannot be before the next generation date.
errors.alreadyGeneratedToday: A draft was already created from this template today.
errors.mustRemainDraft: Generation must stay a draft. Nothing was posted.
errors.kindMismatch: The saved template type does not match the payload.
